title: How To Save Half A Litre Of Water (and Some Money!) With Every Flush By Using Our Oli In-wall Cisterns
bodyHtml:
View original embedded media

Your toilet alone uses roughly 26% of the water consumption in an average Australian household (yourhome.gov.au) so if you’re considering a new bathroom remodel, it’s time to start thinking about how you can reduce your ongoing water usage by choosing an efficient toilet installation.

In this article, we’ll discuss how you can shave real dollars off your water bill with every flush, by installing our Oli in-wall cistern system in your next bathroom reno project.

As we push towards a more considered approach to sustainable practices in bath ware, Studio Bagno is proudly the official Australian agent for OLI toilet cisterns. For over 60 years, Oli’s focus on innovation and leading edge technology has gained a an international reputation . One such innovation is the development of the ‘Azor Plus inlet valve’ - a water-saving solution that equips all our in-wall cisterns; the Oli 74 and the Expert Evo.

This advanced technology makes the Oli 74 and Expert Evo the only cisterns on the Australian market that features a delayed refill, resulting in massive dollar savings for households, hospitality and commercial applications alike.

The decreased consumption of water is due to the delayed refilling of water in the cistern, preventing it from filling while the flush valve is opened, thus avoiding water waste during flushing. Filling ONLY begins after closing the flush valve, meaning all water flushed is efficiently used for cleaning the toilet. This inlet valve is not only ecological, but also quiet in operation making it an excellent choice in any bathroom where an in-wall cistern is preferred. See below:

How Oli Cisterns can save you up to 9L/Day!

All Oli cisterns are 100% made in Europe and every product is flush and water tested post assembly, ensuring that the product is consistently quality assured.

Perfect for the Contemporary Bathroom!

In-wall cisterns aren’t just for saving water and money, they are also a great option when going for a refined design aesthetic. Not only are they minimalist and unobtrusive , they maximise the space in your bathroom because the flushing components are hidden inside your wall. That’s an automatic saving of around 150mm, which we can further take advantage of by pairing with a short projection wall faced toilet resulting in even more space saving! Using an in-wall cistern also means that you can customise your flush button plate to match tap ware or other features of your bathroom design. With over 10 styles and endless colour and finish options thanks to our customisable Blink Plate, you can be sure that your toilet setup can create the design aesthetic you’ve always dreamed of.
